title: Figure 3.7. United Kingdom: Deflation in the Aftermath of World War I
text:
Figure 3.7. United Kingdom: Deflation in the Aftermath of World War I

After World War I, the United Kingdom experienced strong deflation, anemic growth, and high unemployment. Despite large primary surpluses, the debt ratio continued to increase due to high nominal interest rates and deflation.
